venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sun 9/13 (MOD KE, Chef DM).** Net $958 vs $1,380 target (69%); food $166; comps $43.35 (4.5%) — one tab issue comped, otherwise a typical industry night; 36 guests / $26.61 avg. Fairly quiet night with very little foot traffic; the usual industry late-night pop didn't materialize, though a handful of industry folks came in. After the Titans game there was a decent push of guests in jerseys who came hungry rather than pay stadium food prices — Joe flagged a possible post-game promo opportunity. Kitchen: slow food night with the smaller crowd. 86'd: Taco Tuesday until Tuesday; Guinness cans only until draft restocked. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: two guests with excellent Americana/folk recommendations who loved the Yuzu Gin & Tonic. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sun 9/13 (AM Maggie H; PM Carey).** Total net incl. events $7,160.71 vs $10,791 target (66%); DC/AM $970.79, D&C PM $6,189.92; no events; total food $1,732.70; comps $192.75 (2.69%); 150 guests (Tock) / ~$47.74 avg. AM: a little slower Sunday with Heather Ramsey — found the flow and crushed it. PM: very sleepy Sunday on the Front Range with lots of early cuts to offset the lack of business; hoping football season gets people back out. Kitchen: super chill Sunday with Dante. Break make-up complete; no-shows not charged; no incidents; no maintenance needs. Favorite moment: Cosette and Mike getting real reps behind Marquee. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Sun 9/13 (Kyler & team).** Total EOD net $3,980 vs $3,925 target (101%); food $212, beverage $3,768; comps $82.80; 122 covers (SevenRooms) / $33 avg; 0 investor cocktails. First turn had a full bar but quiet floor, then a few pulses of busyness before dispersing after 10pm; clientele skewed heavily to out-of-town vacationers and photo-conscious guests. Lack of full food made it hard to hold a full-service atmosphere. Top sellers: Burner Phone, Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri, chips & dip. Door: sticky night with a few waiting at open; another fashion-week event down the street; near capacity around 8–9pm then very quiet by 10; Micah staged at the door. No no-shows. Menu count 17; breakage: sidecar, 2 DOF. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Sun 9/13 (Joe, Angel, Josh).** Net $5,344 vs $4,889 target (109%); food $935; standing room closed ($0); comps $40.60 (investors, industry, DNL); 136 guests / $87.61 avg. Opened with a humble 15 covers; Madison's first training shift on the floor and Angel training in the kitchen with Chef Josh — both crushed it. Active first hour with walk-ins and pre-dinner stops; room completely full by 7:30pm with a ~20-person waitlist; most resos around 8pm and the team burned and turned to fit as many parties as possible, keeping the room full through last call. Kitchen: nice work as usual. No incidents; no-shows charged. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sun 9/13 (AM Justin & Shannon/Lex; PM James & Marcus).** Total net $7,762 vs $6,060 target (128%); Municipal Bar AM $3,253 (106 guests), PM $3,147 (40 guests), Sun Club $125, Hot Eye $1,124; food $2,835; no events; comps $360; 146 guests / ~$53.16 avg. AM: a few tables before 9am and a couple larger IRD orders before 10, quiet until everyone arrived at 11 and filled the whole place; kitchen fought long ticket times and FOH was staffed perfectly for the rush; two large food tours back-to-back handled smoothly; quiet again by happy hour. PM: slow evening, ~6 tables at the 8:30 peak; bar was transient single-drink traffic; ran a very slim crew (one bartender, two servers). Sun Club: chill day, a few banana daiquiris; lights still out and two umbrellas not opening properly. Hot Eye: slow night with the usual 9pm bar-crawl pop, then a decent service-industry crowd at 11:30 and return hotel guests; back-bar cleaning done. Kitchen: painfully slow, no 86s going into tomorrow. No incidents. Favorite moment: hotel guests Sean & Sam (room 307), who will be back next year. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sun 9/13 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net $8,312 vs $6,000 target (139%); food $744; comps $454 (~$100 shifties, a few cocktail DNLs); 184 guests / $45.17 avg. Finally a slightly slower shift to catch their breath; Julian worked the kitchen most of the night with great success (didn't run out of cheese — though blue cheese did run out). Malachi did an amazing job on the door; Curtis helped get things off the ground before departing around 10. Missed the ice-delivery cutoff, so running spheres until Tuesday. Sundays are shaping up as an industry-friends night. 86'd/low: well gin. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: AT breaking a glass. Entered by Julian Abel.
